description: This file defines the `EcuDefinition` interface for the RomRaider project, specifying methods related to ECU definitions such as retrieving IDs, car info, inheritance info, and associated files.

classes.name: EcuDefinition
classes.description: An interface representing ECU definition properties and methods in the RomRaider project.

methods.name: getEcuId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the ECU.

methods.name: getCalId
methods.description: Returns the calibration ID associated with the ECU.

methods.name: getCarString
methods.description: Returns a string description of the car related to the ECU.

methods.name: getInherits
methods.description: Returns inheritance information for the ECU definition.

methods.name: getEcuDefFile
methods.description: Returns the File object referencing the ECU definition file.
